name: Madurai
desc: Serving families and business owners across Madurai, Tamil Nadu, Insurance Support offers independent, IRDAI-certified consultancy. From high-sum-assured term plans to family floater health policies, we help you secure the right coverage with full claim recovery backup.
it_focus: Group health and term insurance for employees at Kappalur Sector and Madurai IT Park.
senior_focus: Senior citizen health insurance and pension advisory for established families around Goripalayam and Tallakulam.
branch_dets: Coordination with LIC branch at West Tower road and major insurers at Anna Nagar.

local_faqs.question: Which Madurai hospitals accept cashless health insurance?
local_faqs.answer: Apollo Specialty Hospitals Madurai, Vasantha Mission Hospital, Meenakshi Mission Hospital, and Remedy Hospital are in our cashless network.

local_faqs.question: Do you help small businesses with insurance in Madurai?
local_faqs.answer: Yes, we structure shop insurance, burglary, public liability, and group mediclaim for small businesses and traders in Madurai.
